title: Hyper Toad: Frog Tongue Arcade
fullDescription:
HYPER TOAD — flick, catch, survive!

Become a hungry frog with a lightning tongue in the ultimate frog game. Hop across the pond, snap the right bug with one quick tongue flick, and dodge the giant frog bosses that want YOU for lunch.

Hyper Toad is a fast 3D frog arcade game built for quick sessions and big high scores. Every level is a froggy reflex game that tests your hand eye coordination game skills: time your tongue, judge the frog jump game timing, and react before the insects scatter. Miss your target and a monstrous boss closes in — land the perfect catch and grow your combo.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
• 50 hand-crafted levels of arcade frog game action
• A true bug catcher game — one-tap tongue control, easy to learn, hard to master
• Giant-frog boss fights: a reaction game that tests your timing
• Unlockable skins, from classic toad game hero to golden froggy
• A calm pond game world with a dark, neon arcade game edge
• Daily and weekly missions to chase

Great for fans of any frog tongue game, animal hunting game, swamp game, or endless score chase. Part frog simulator, part bug hunting game, Hyper Toad turns a simple toad hunter into a tense frog adventure, hopping the lily pad maze of every level.

Sharpen your aim. Read the swamp. Beat every boss.
Download Hyper Toad and start the hunt.
shortDescription: Flick your tongue, catch bugs, dodge giant frogs in 50 reflex arcade levels.
